sentence: Tracks shared expenses with a payer and the people splitting each one, works out the fewest payments to settle up, and lets the person being paid confirm that money arrived.
use_when: a group shared costs like rides, food or tickets and needs to know who owes who
someone wants to add an expense and split it among everyone in the chat
people want to opt in or out of a shared cost
the group wants to mark payments as received and see what is left
dont_use_when: a single yes/no or multiple choice vote is needed, which is a poll
money has to actually be sent or collected through a payment service
a recurring budget or long-term expense report is needed
